evidence.snippet: Careers page lists multiple Account Executive openings.
Blog post mentions expanding the go-to-market team.
Press release about opening an EMEA office.
Series B announced with a named lead investor.
Funding used to scale sales and marketing.
Pricing page shows team and enterprise plans.
Leadership page lists a VP of Sales.
Public integrations directory and security page.

strategy.summary: Outbound plan for selling into the prospect (not advice for their leadership). Lead with public hiring + funding as timing signals. First thread: prospect VP Sales / RevOps. Position a short pilot against AE ramp or pipeline hygiene metrics the seller can measure with them.
whyNow: Prospect hiring and funding suggest GTM tooling budget this cycle.
Multi-market expansion at the prospect increases coordination pain sellers can attach to.

talkTracks.title: Hiring velocity (seller → prospect)
talkTracks.script: Saw you are adding AEs after the raise — peers in that phase often hit ramp and marketing→sales handoffs. Worth comparing how you run that loop today?

discoveryQuestions: Questions for the prospect contact: how many AEs is the team ramping this quarter?
At the prospect: who owns the outbound / pipeline tech stack and buying process?
risksAndObjections: Prospect may already have a preferred stack funded by the last raise — validate before pitching rip-and-replace.
nextSteps: Book a 20-minute discovery with prospect RevOps (seller calendars it)
Share two peer case studies relevant to the prospect’s motion
Propose a 30-day pilot the prospect can accept on one pod
